tagline: Live classes, attendance, messaging and branch control for our institute and its franchise branches. Everything planned, built and waiting, in one place.
headline: Planning done: PRD and build rules written. Next: Phase 0 Foundation.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.summary: Project setup, database, secure login, role menus, audit log, look and feel, test setup
phases.check: Log in as each demo role and see the right menu on phone and laptop.

phases.name: Organisation
phases.summary: Branches, rooms, departments, designations, admins and modules, employees, students, Excel import, settings, holidays
phases.check: Create a branch, add a Branch Admin, bulk-upload 20 students from Excel.

phases.name: Academics
phases.summary: Course catalogue, branch course requests, batches with automatic sessions, enrolments, timetable
phases.check: Create the Python Full Stack course and Morning Batch A, enrol students, see the timetable.

phases.name: Live class: core
phases.summary: Our own class room: video, audio, screen share, chat, raise hand, teacher controls, entry restrictions
phases.check: Run a class from two browsers (teacher + student), try every button, try joining as a non-enrolled student.

phases.name: Live class: attendance, polls, whiteboard, recording
phases.summary: Automatic and check-in attendance, offline and hybrid roster, attendance requests, polls, whiteboard, recordings
phases.check: Hold a class, run a poll, request attendance as a student and approve it as the teacher, watch the recording.

phases.name: Learning portal
phases.summary: Materials, per-class performance, two-way feedback, final project approval, student reports
phases.check: Upload notes, give marks and feedback, take a project from submission to Completed.

phases.name: Messaging & staff meetings
phases.summary: 1-to-1 chat, batch groups, staff groups, announcements, files, moderation, meetings from chat
phases.check: Chat as a student and a teacher, post an announcement, start a staff meeting.

phases.name: Accounts
phases.summary: Fee plans, instalments, manual payments, receipts, approvals, dues, collections reports
phases.check: Set a fee plan, record a UPI payment, open the receipt, check the dues list.

phases.name: Notifications & help desk
phases.summary: Email, SMS, web push, notification centre, preferences, help desk tickets with SLA
phases.check: Receive class and fee notifications; raise and resolve a help desk ticket.

phases.name: Monitoring
phases.summary: Network and branch KPI dashboards, live-now monitor, rankings, exports, weekly summary
phases.check: Compare branches on all 7 KPIs and check the numbers against the demo data.

phases.name: Hardening & launch
phases.summary: Load test with 200 classes, security review, India hosting, backups, acceptance test, go-live
phases.check: Final sign-off with the PRD acceptance checklist (§21).

phases.name: Planning & your extra requests
phases.summary: Product plan, build rules and anything you ask for between phases
phases.check: Read the PRD summary and confirm the decisions.

cards.d: 20 questions answered: size, roles, class types, attendance, recordings, fees, chat, KPIs, notifications.
Every role, screen, rule, notification and KPI for version 1, plus phases and the acceptance checklist.
Technology choices, security rules, testing gates, Git rules and the supervised / unsupervised modes.
This page: phases, board, screens, decisions and code status.

cards.t: Read the PRD and confirm decisions D1–D12
cards.d: Defaults are already used; tell me anything you want changed.
cards.w: Your turn: reply with any changes, or "approved".

cards.d: Website, server and shared rules in one project; local database and class server start together.
Branches, people, courses, batches, sessions, attendance, money, messages, tickets; changes through migrations.
Email or mobile + password, lockout after 5 wrong tries, first-login password change, forgot password.
Every request checked on the server; Branch Admins can never see another branch.
Who did what and when, for every important action.

cards.t: Look and feel, menus per role
cards.d: Phone-first layouts, sidebar menus for Super Admin, Admin, Branch Admin, Teacher, Accountant, Student.
Unit, server and headless browser tests plus a recorded screen walkthrough, run before anything is called done.
3 branches and a login for every role so you can click through straight away.
Create, edit and close branches; branch codes; rooms with capacity; branch holidays.
Super Admin creates Admins and ticks the modules each one controls (Head of Accounts = Accounts module).
Head-office templates, branch additions, a permission set per designation.
Add, edit, deactivate; home branch plus extra branches for teachers; welcome email/SMS.
Add, edit, statuses, guardian details (no guardian login), auto student ID.
Download template, upload, see row-by-row errors, import the good rows.
Branding, ID formats, all rule numbers from the PRD, head-office holiday list.
Search every recorded action by date, person, branch and action.
Courses with hours, syllabus modules, default fee; draft, publish, retire.
Branch proposes a course; head office approves, rejects or sends back.
Teacher, days, times, room, capacity; sessions created automatically, skipping holidays.
Per session; students notified; teacher and room clash warnings.
Enrol, move batch, hold, drop with reason; one student in many batches and branches.
Day, week and month views for students, teachers and the branch.
Self-hosted live video server; no Zoom, Meet or Teams.
Test camera, mic and speaker before entering.
Gallery and speaker views; teacher can let a student share.
Chat saved with the session; teacher can turn student chat off.
Mute one/all, camera off, stop share, remove, lock room, allow mic/camera.
Only enrolled students, teacher, added guests and silent observers; a second device disconnects the first.
Join and take part from Android and iPhone browsers.
Present at 75% time in class, Late after 10 minutes; reconnects counted correctly.
Teacher opens a 2-minute window; students tap I'm present.
Teacher marks the room on phone or laptop; each student marked once.
Student requests within 3 days; teacher approves or rejects; escalates to Branch Admin after 2 days.
Single or multiple choice, live results, saved with the session.
Shared drawing board; give a student the pen; save to materials.
Auto-record, batch-only access, no download, name watermark, 180-day retention.
cards.w: Needs a Linux test server to verify real recordings (D12).

cards.d: Rename, hide, replace, delete (recoverable 7 days), all audited.
Files and links per batch, session or module; share across batches.
Quick grid for 1–5 marks and remarks; running average for the student.
Teacher feedback to students; star rating after each class; end-of-course forms.
Student submits, teacher reviews (changes or approve), Branch Admin gives final approval → Completed.
Attendance, performance, payment and dues statements.
Next class with Join button, today's timetable, attendance %, dues, unread messages.
Student ↔ teacher/staff, staff ↔ staff across branches; no student-to-student DMs.
Auto group per batch (can be announcements-only); staff create their own groups.
Everything you'd expect from Teams-style chat.
Head office → branches, Branch Admin → branch or batches, with read counts.
Admins review chats with students and hide messages, with a reason; audited.
Instant or scheduled meetings for staff, and calls started from a chat.
Default fee from head office, branch prices, Head of Accounts can lock them.
Per enrolment; discounts above 10% need Head of Accounts approval.

cards.t: Record a payment and receipt PDF
cards.d: Cash, UPI, bank, card, cheque, DD; receipt number never repeats or skips; emailed to student.
Payments are never edited; voids need approval; everything audited.
Due soon, due today, overdue; automatic and one-click reminders.
By branch, course, batch, date, method; day-close report; Excel export.
Bell icon, browser push, preferences per person.
Welcome, password, class changes, receipts, project and ticket emails.
OTP, class changes, fee reminders, receipts with DLT templates.
cards.w: DLT template IDs and wording for each SMS (D10).

cards.d: Right people, right channels, editable wording.
Raise, reply, statuses, reopen within 7 days, attachments.
First reply within 1 business day; escalate to Help Desk Admin after 3.
All 7 KPIs, branch ranking, red/amber/green, trends.
KPIs per batch and per teacher.
Classes running, students in class, classes that should have started.
Every table to Excel; weekly email to Super Admin and Admins.
Simulated 200 rooms × 40 people on the live-class servers.
Every role and branch wall re-checked; dependency and configuration review.
Servers, database, files and recordings in Mumbai; daily backups.
DPDP Act 2023 / Rules 2025; guardian consent for under-18s; data deletion requests.
The app at your own web address.
Online copy of the code; production only changes through reviewed merges.
Click through every screen with the PRD checklist and sign off.

decisions.text: Product name, logo and brand colours
Attendance rules: Present at 75% of class time, Late after 10 min, 2-minute check-in
Recordings kept 180 days, no download, viewer-name watermark
Discounts above 10% need Head of Accounts approval
Teachers see average ratings only, not who rated them
Do we have students under 18? (guardian consent under the DPDP Act)
Monthly hosting budget for live video and recording servers (200 classes)
decisions.default: Self-hosted in AWS Mumbai; estimate given in Phase 10

decisions.text: Reuse our existing SMS gateway account and DLT templates
A Linux test server so real class recordings can be tested
decisions.default: Needed by Phase 4; dev uses a sample recording until then

decisions.text: Technology: React web app, Node.js (NestJS) server, PostgreSQL database, self-hosted LiveKit for live video
Working modes: say "supervised" (stop after each phase) or "unsupervised" (build phase after phase, test everything, stop only for things only you can give)
